checks.name: ck_costing_values

checks.name: ck_erd_plan

checks.name: ck_erd_shortage

checks.name: ck_erd_stage_state

checks.name: ck_erd_stock_item

checks.name: ck_erd_stock_numbers
checks.clause: ((`quantity_after` >= 0) and (((`quantity_status_before` = _utf8mb4\'verified\') and (`quantity_before` is not null) and (`quantity_before` >= 0) and (`quantity_delta` is not null) and (`quantity_after` = (`quantity_before` + `quantity_delta`))) or ((`quantity_status_before` in (_utf8mb4\'unknown\',_utf8mb4\'provisional_sample\')) and (`quantity_before` is null) and (`quantity_delta` is null) and (`kind` in (_utf8mb4\'observation\',_utf8mb4\'opening\',_utf8mb4\'correction\')))))

checks.name: ck_erd_stock_owner

checks.name: ck_finished_provenance

checks.name: ck_inquiry_source

checks.name: ck_material_prices

checks.name: ck_material_stock

checks.name: ck_order_archive
checks.clause: (((`archived_at` is null) and (`archived_by` is null) and (`archive_reason` is null) and (`archive_note` is null)) or ((`archived_at` is not null) and (`archived_by` is not null) and (`archive_reason` is not null) and (`archive_note` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`archive_note`)) > 0)))

checks.name: ck_po_clear

checks.name: ck_po_review

checks.name: ck_production_reason

checks.name: ck_production_stage_event

checks.name: ck_request_provenance

checks.name: ck_response_provenance

checks.name: ck_signed_dr_state
